fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-07-31, the complainant found that persons had entered a closed premises near Nallur Garden Residential Colony without permission. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-07-31 at approximately 11:00. Lavanya Ammal approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000175. The complaint mentions Sanjay Gopal, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000073, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unauthorised entry reportedly noticed after the premises were locked.
fields.Keywords: trespass, unauthorised entry, mobile number, photograph, residential colony, CCTV, suspect, morning
